rows.note: Use this for the dental-filling treatment or the resulting repair, rather than the material itself.

example.english: I'm going for a filling today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 bou2 ngaa4

rows.note: Use this for the filling material itself, including material placed in a tooth.

example.english: This filling material is used to fill a cavity.
example.traditional: 呢種填充物係用嚟塞牙窿嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 tin4 cung1 mat6 hai6 jung6 lei4 sak1 ngaa4 lung4 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a food filling, including pie filling.

example.english: The filling in this apple pie smells great.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 gwo2 pai1 ge3 haam5 hou2 hoeng1
